issues.event: Stripe Projects CLI launch by Patrick Collison
issues.article_text: Patrick Collison lançou o Stripe Projects, CLI que permite agentes de IA provisionar Vercel, Supabase e PostHog com um comando, eliminando a montagem manual que Andrej Karpathy identificou como gargalo do "vibe-coding".
issues.detail: Patrick Collison's announcement tweet and the projects.dev product page are both dated 2026-03-26, one day before the research window opened.

issues.event: Shield AI raises $2B Series G at $12.7B valuation
issues.article_text: A Shield AI captou [$2bi na Series G a $12,7bi] e projeta [$540mi em receita para 2026].
issues.detail: TechCrunch published the story on 2026-03-26; Janes confirms the announcement was made on March 26, 2026. Both predate the research window.

issues.event: Meta lays off 700 employees across Reality Labs and other divisions
issues.article_text: A Meta cortou 700 empregos — 25 mil desde 2022 — incluindo estúdios de VR, um dia após revelar plano executivo de $921mi.
issues.detail: Research key_fact states cuts happened on March 25. Public reporting broke on March 27 (within window), but the event itself occurred two days before the window opened.

issues.event: FDA approves Kresladi gene therapy for LAD-1
issues.article_text: A FDA aprovou o Kresladi da Rocket Pharmaceuticals para deficiência de adesão leucocitária tipo 1, doença ultra-rara com ~25 novos casos/ano.
issues.detail: STAT News URL is dated 2026-03-26 and the article states FDA approved 'on Thursday' (March 26). The approval predates the research window by one day.
